deng._notBeforeWords: 等 followed by these asks how long to wait (等多久, 等几分钟), not etc.; 等多种格式 still counts. notAfter also holds 然后等 / 再等 / 先等 (waiting)

_fillers: Voice-typing filler sounds, removed before matching: 嗯、呃、 is not a list. 啊 and 哈 stay (words in 什么 A 啊 B 啊), and so does 额 (金额、余额).

patterns._comment: Context-sensitive triggers (JavaScript regex, case-insensitive). 'like this/that' as 'of this kind', not 'I like this'; 这种情况 but not 这种情况下.
patterns.这样的问题: (?:这样|这种|这类|那种|那样)的?(?:问题|情况|错误|bug|毛病|地方|东西)(?!下)

notUser._comment: Text that reaches the hook but was not typed by the user: other sessions, sub-agents, background and scheduled runs. Wrapped blocks are dropped; a prompt that starts with one of the 'starts' patterns (JavaScript regex, case-insensitive) is not the user's at all.
starts: This session is being continued from a previous conversation
notUser._trailers: Notes the host appends after a relayed message (JavaScript regex): removed, so they do not count as the user's words.
trailers: That "other Claude session" is an agent working inside this same session[\s\S]*$
notUser._asked: A relayed message still turns full mode on when it is a new task (task) that explicitly asks for the method (ask): a coordinator writing 'use the big picture on this'. Recognition is by these fixed words only, so anyone who types them is believed, and a relayed message that does not use them is never recognised (see README, 'Limits').

asked.ask: (?<!不|别|不要|无需|没|勿|别再)(?:用|按|以|走)\s*(?:大局观|全局观)|(?<![\w./~-])/dajuguan(?![\w-])|(?<!(?:don't|do not|no need to|not|never)\s)\b(?:use|apply) (?:the )?(?:dajuguan|big[- ]picture)(?![\w-])

_message: What the hook adds to the assistant's context in full mode, one line each; {why} is the reason it fired. always-on.md and the skill say the same (test/trigger.test.mjs checks).
message: [dajuguan] Big-picture FULL mode ({why}). Reply in the user's language; do this first, briefly:

1. Read the message: an example inside a request is a sample of the scope, so widen it; a hypothetical, a remark or a relayed report is not a request, so don't turn it into tasks (a message that opens with a fixed header or wrapper, such as a thread header or a system notice, is machine text); a simple yes/no or factual question: just answer it.
2. Write the original intent and the success criterion, one line each.
3. Widen on kin, impact, options and failure modes; every item must trace back to the intent, or it goes to Drop. A limit the user set (only this, only analyse, no new plan, in a hurry) is the scope.

4. Open the reply with the three columns, 12 lines at most, one line per item: the marker [Big picture · …] (Chinese replies: 【大局观 · …】), then Do now · Propose first (needs the user) · Drop (why). The analysis comes after.
5. Prefer a reusable mechanism to a one-off patch; for a standing rule the user set, say where it is enforced (a template, a hook, a check), not just that it was noted.
6. Reversible: do it, then tell. A default you chose for the user: record it and say it can be changed.
7. If your commitments to the user changed this turn, end with one line: commitments +new / done / waiting on you.
The marker is for the user: never put it on messages to other sessions or sub-agents.
